---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the reverse-connect listener
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the scenario where it would be useful — for example, a topology this listener does not handle today, an event you would like dispatched, a validator rule that is missing.

## Proposed Solution

How you think this could be implemented (optional).

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered — including whether the feature might belong in `php-opcua/opcua-client` (the core) instead of this extension.

## Additional Context

Any additional context, references to OPC UA Part 6 §7.1.2.3 (or other spec sections), and examples from other OPC UA stacks that already implement the feature you have in mind.
